valid.name: all builtin string tokens normalize to objects
styled custom tokens and per-agent replacement
valid.toml:
[ui]
agent_panel_sort = "priority"
[ui.sidebar.agents]
row_gap = 1
rows = [["state_icon", { token = "terminal_title_stripped", fg = "#6c7086", dim = false }], [{ token = "$pin_icon", fg = "#AbC", bold = false }, { token = "workspace", dim = true }, { token = "agent", bold = true }]]
[ui.sidebar.agents.rows_by_agent]
claude = [["terminal_title_stripped"]]
codex = [["$task-1"]]

valid.name: machine styled alone in a row
herdr 0.9.4 documented rules example
valid.toml:
[ui.sidebar.agents]
rows = [
  ["state_icon", "workspace", "tab"],
  [{ token = "machine", fg = "#fff", rules = [{ equals = "Local", fg = "#f55" }, { equals = "Fedora", ignore_case = true, fg = "#51a2da" }] }, "agent"],
  [{ token = "$load", fg = "#fff", rules = [{ gt = 80, fg = "#f55", bold = true }, { gt = 50, fg = "#fc0" }] }],
]

valid.name: rules inside an override
valid.toml:
[ui.sidebar.agents]
rows = [["agent"]]
[ui.sidebar.agents.rows_by_agent]
pi = [[{ token = "$load", rules = [{ gt = 80, dim = false }, { lt = 20.5, dim = true }] }]]

valid.name: rule hide
valid.toml:
[ui.sidebar.agents]
rows = [[{ token = "machine", fg = "#61afef", rules = [{ equals = "Local", hide = true }] }, "agent"]]

valid.name: byte-order mark displaced to a line start
byte-order mark displaced to a CRLF line start
U+FEFF at a line start inside a multi-line rule string is kept

invalid.name: unknown builtin resets sort and whole layout
rows by agent is not a table
invalid override resets valid main layout
custom token trailing newline is invalid
seventeen rules
invalid.toml:
[ui.sidebar.agents]
rows = [[{ token = "$load", rules = [{ equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }, { equals = 'x' }] }]]

invalid.name: ignore_case next to gt
invalid.toml:
[ui.sidebar.agents]
rows = [[{ token = "$load", rules = [{ gt = 80, ignore_case = false }] }]]

invalid.name: unknown rule key
invalid.toml:
[ui.sidebar.agents]
rows = [[{ token = "agent", rules = [{ equals = "x", underline = true }] }]]
